- Optimized interiors

- Optimized Volumetric fog

- Optimized Post Processing

- Optimized Bloom

Hello Demo Playtesters! The Day 1 Patch is about to arrive. Here are the patch notes!


Fixed Door Positioning in Player house

Fixed Door Positioning in Creejs house

Fixed floating or poor positioning on decor

Fixed the dining table causing Creej to catch you from across the map

Fixed the Catch animation sometimes being off-centered

Fixed Creej lower responsivity than normal

Added a 'Reset game' option so if a game breaking bug occurs, you dont have to restart in the dev menu

Added 'Tick Optimization' in the dev menu, this changes how many times the game's code updates per second. Putting this at high levels will drasticly lower AI responsivity, however will reduce any cpu bottlenecks on lower end hardware.

Fixed pressing V causing the players capsule to go 'everywhere'

changed the Auto graphics option to improve your fps more

changed the 'lower' graphics option to be way lower

Fixed camera shake playing when caught

Fixed window sometimes rotating the player's role axis
